description: Recent pilot reports (PIREPs) within a distance of an airport: turbulence and icing with intensity, altitude, aircraft type and time, plus a tally of how many reports found none, light, moderate or severe turbulence. PIREPs are the only first-hand reports of turbulence actually encountered, so they answer "is it bumpy around Denver right now" for pilots and nervous flyers. Source: NOAA/NWS Aviation Weather Center; coverage is mainly the United States. Reports are sparse and individual; not for flight planning. (cost: 1 credit)

age_hours.description: integer, optional, how far back to look in hours, 1-24, default 3

distance_nm.description: integer, optional, radius in nautical miles, 5-500, default 100

icao.description: string, required, ICAO airport code at the centre of the search (e.g. KDEN)

limit.description: integer, optional, reports to list (newest first), 1-100, default 25

name: pireps_near_airport
